questions.content: A boy reaches the airport and finds that the escalator is not working. He walks up the stationary escalator in time t<sub>1</sub>. If he remains stationary on a moving escalator then the escalator takes him up in time t<sub>2</sub>. The time taken by him to walk up on the moving escalator will be :
